fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on Miami-area politics and public utilities, including arguments for municipal takeover of Florida Power & Light and discussion of Jacksonville’s gas-rate reduction efforts. Coverage also includes a court-related scandal involving an annulment case, crime and municipal court proceedings (including drunk driving and assault cases), and commentary on vice/nightlife. Additional items address Dade County zoning enforcement against an elderly resident’s trailer, a Miami Chamber of Commerce tourism promotion plan, a Pan American World Airways flight carrying a five-day-old infant, and columns summarizing Florida Attorney General opinions, teacher certification statistics, foreign trade balance concerns, and national topics such as foundations/tax issues and labor law.
